@graph.description: A landing page is a conversion tool. A real website is proof. Here's why established Metro Detroit businesses lose credibility, leads, and revenue on a landing page — and what a professional web presence actually includes.

about.name: Professional Website Building for Established Businesses

keywords: why your business needs a real website

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a landing page and a real website?

acceptedAnswer.text: A landing page is a single page built to convert one campaign. A real website is a multi-page proof system — services, proof, contact, trust signals, and content — built to represent an established business. One is a tool; the other is your business online.

mainEntity.name: Why do established businesses lose credibility with only a landing page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prospects judge credibility in about 50 milliseconds, and 75% of consumers judge a company's credibility based on website design alone. A thin page signals that the business hasn't invested in its presence — regardless of how good its reputation actually is.

mainEntity.name: What should a professional business website include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Specific services, visible proof (work, testimonials, licensing), a real contact path, trust signals, content that answers prospect questions, proper local SEO, and fast mobile-first performance.

mainEntity.name: How much does a professional website for a small business cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: It varies with scope, but a real, proof-focused site is a fraction of what one lost high-value client is worth — and unlike template subscriptions, you own the result. Agentic quotes honestly per business because every site is scoped to what the business actually sells.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a professional website?

acceptedAnswer.text: A focused build typically takes a few weeks — discovery, structure, copy, design, and launch. The speed isn't the point; the proof is.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a real website if my business already gets leads?

acceptedAnswer.text: If those leads come from referrals that get checked online, yes. A thin web presence can quietly convert your best referral into a competitor's client before you ever hear about it.

mainEntity.name: Can a landing page be converted into a full website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — that's exactly the project. Agentic starts from the landing page's offer and builds out the services, proof, and trust structure around it.
